major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown for the damage boost and the faster Thunder Clap cadence.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cooldown on the table is 90s; the guide says it comes back roughly every minute and the sampled parses average one cast per 58s of combat, so the effective 60s is used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Demoralizing Shout
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown for the Booming Voice rage and the damage cut on everything around you.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1160 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses; 1298899 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown once Colossal Might is at 3 stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 436358 is the castable Colossus id per its tooltip; the sampled parses ran Mountain Thane and never pressed it, and 440884/440886/440888 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Shield Charge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Charge in on cooldown for the free Shield Block and the stun.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Logs record the cast as 385954 in 5/5 parses; the same-name id 385952 carries the 45s base cooldown in the table.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on cooldown and Thunder Clap under it to keep Rend ticking.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228920 is the castable id per its tooltip; 156287 and 334934 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Champion's Spear
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it on cooldown to chain the pack in place and add burst damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 376079 is the castable spear id per its tooltip; 1271980 is the follow-up leap and 376080/376081 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Wrecking Throw
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it when Shield Slam, Thunder Clap, and Revenge are all unavailable.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 384110 is the cast id seen in 4/5 parses; 394354 shares the name and was not observed. Javelineer builds only.

defensives.name: Shield Block
defensives.usage_rule: Keep it up through melee damage and recast it before the buff falls off.
defensives.id_note: 2565 is the cast id; 132404 is the aura the logs carry.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Time it into a cast aimed at you to reflect it and cut the magic damage.
defensives.id_note: 23920 is the cast id; 385391 is the aura twin.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Press it when your health dips to heal for 30% of your maximum.
defensives.id_note: 202168 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses; 202166 shares the name and was not observed.

defensives.name: Demoralizing Shout
defensives.usage_rule: Use it into melee damage windows to weaken everything hitting you.

defensives.name: Shield Wall
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to smooth the biggest tank hits rather than saving it for nothing.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Pop it ahead of raid-wide damage to give the group a health buffer.
defensives.id_note: 97462 is the cast id; 97463 is the aura.

rules.description: Open with Charge, Avatar, Demo Shout, then Shield Slam
rules.action: Charge in, fire Avatar and Demoralizing Shout, then start the Shield Slam cycle.

rules.description: Keep Shield Block up on melee damage
rules.action: Recast Shield Block before the buff falls off so you never eat melee swings unblocked.

rules.description: Dump into Ignore Pain only near the rage cap
rules.action: Hold Ignore Pain until your rage is about to cap instead of dumping it early.
